extractions.value: Autopsy revealed unilateral axonal swelling, chromatolysis and vacuolisation of anterior horn cells of the lower spinal cord, accompanied by microglia proliferation and discrete infiltration of CD8+ cytotoxic T cells. No CD4+ T helper cells, B cells or complement deposition were detected. The patient carried the HLA-DRB1*0301 allele. Serum creatinine increased gradually to 1717 units/ml (normal <270 U/ml), but normalized 3 months later.
